messages:
Nina: Quick sweep: Legal flagged a few UI nits on Compliance > Storage card. Can we do copy + a11y before the next doc freeze?
Omar: Got it. Which lines are problematic?
Nina: 1) Retention label is vague about start date. 2) KMS badge text just says 'Encrypted' which isn't explicit about who controls the key.
Zoe: For retention: propose 'Retention (starts on creation)'. Helper: 'Data is removed after this period.' Short and clear.
Ravi: Agreed. For KMS: two variants 'Encrypted — Customer KMS' and 'Encrypted — Redwood KMS'. Keep it visible and also in ARIA.
ui-bot: Component note: statusBadge used in multiple pages; changing text may require compact variant for narrow layouts.
accessibility-bot: Scan: badge missing accessible name. Recommend aria-label that matches visible text and tabindex for keyboard focus.
Omar: Also the lock icon contrast is low on light grey; bump color to meet AA.
Zoe: Region fallback copy: don't only say 'Fallback'. Use 'Using fallback region: us-west-2 (primary eu-central-1 unavailable)'. Be explicit.
Ravi: Audit action button currently 'Download' 013 legal wants 'Export audit log (CSV)' for clarity.
Nina: Also logs use inconsistent verbs: 'token used' vs 'API key used'. Standardize to 'API key used' across events.
Omar: Mobile note: retention slider layout breaks at 320px. Suggest swap to select on small screens.
ui-bot: Implementation estimate: add aria-labels + compact badge + mobile select ~3-4 hrs. Contrast update separate ~30 mins.
Zoe: I'll draft final strings: 1) Retention label: 'Retention (starts on creation)'. Helper: 'Data removed after this period.' 2) Badge visible & aria: 'Encrypted 12 Customer KMS' / 'Encrypted 12 Redwood KMS'. 3) Audit button: 'Export audit log (CSV)'. 4) Region fallback full text.
accessibility-bot: Follow-up scan: if badge exposes ownership via aria-label and has keyboard focus, SR users will get needed context. Manual screen reader check recommended.
Ravi: I'll add a tiny 'Key info' link next to the badge that opens a modal with KMS FAQ and rotation policy (legal requested link).
Nina: Plan: Zoe to drop copy doc, Omar to update component API (a11yLabel, compactMode), Ravi to mock modal. Aim to stage tomorrow AM and run quick a11y smoke.
Omar: Ping me when copy is in Figma and I'll push a staging flag.
Nina: Thanks everyone. Small changes but high impact.
